label: Smart Daylight
info:
Semua logika sistem: AUTO/MANUAL lampu, pintu + buzzer, deteksi offline, REST API, WebSocket.
ESP32 hanya mengirim data & menjalankan perintah.

name: == STATE & PUSTAKA ==
info: Memuat state dari PostgreSQL dan mendefinisikan fungsi bersama (global 'lib').

name: Muat state + pustaka
Logika PINTU + BUZZER
Logika LAMPU AUTO
Status online/offline
Deteksi offline 45 dtk + heartbeat
func: if (!global.get('ready')) return null; const M = [], W = []; const L = global.get('lib')(node, M, W); const { device, wsm, setOffline } = L; try { const d = device(); const STALE_MS = 45000; const age = d.last_seen ? Date.now() - Date.parse(d.last_seen) : null; node.warn('WATCHDOG status=' + d.device_status + ' last_seen=' + d.last_seen + ' age_ms=' + age); if (d.device_status === 'ONLINE' && age !== null && (!Number.isFinite(age) || age > STALE_MS)) { setOffline('tidak ada data lebih dari ' + (STALE_MS / 1000) + ' detik'); } W.push(wsm('device.status', {device_status:d.device_status,last_seen:d.last_seen})); return [M, W]; } catch (e) { node.error(e); return null; }
